title: Rutin alleviates psoriasis-related inflammation in keratinocytes by regulating the JAK2/STAT3 signaling.
authors: Wu, Panhong; Liu, Yonghui; Zhai, Hanxue; Wu, Xiaohan; Liu, Aimin
journal: Skin research and technology : official journal of International Society for Bioengineering and the Skin (ISBS) [and] International Society for Digital Imaging of Skin (ISDIS) [and] International Society for Skin Imaging (ISSI)
one_liner_zh: 该文研究芦丁通过JAK2/STAT3信号通路缓解银屑病角质细胞炎症，仅含STAT3小分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Psoriasis is a chronic inflammatory skin disease that can cause systemic inflammation in various organs. Rutin has been suggested to fight psoriasis, but the signaling pathways by which it works need to be explored. MATERIALS AND METHODS: HaCaT cells co-stimulated with interleukin (IL)-17, IL-22, tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha), IL-1alpha, and oncostatin M (M5) were used as an in vitro cell model of psoriasis. The proliferation and viability of HaCaT cells were determined by 5-ethynyl-2'-deoxyuridine and cell counting assays. Relative mRNA levels of IL-6, TNF-alpha, chemokines (CXCL1 and CXCL2), and anti-microbial peptides (S100A7 and S100A8) were detected by reverse transcriptase-quantitative PCR. Release of IL-6 and TNF-alpha from HaCaT cells was measured by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay. Keratin1, Keratin5, p-JAK2, and p-STAT3 protein levels were estimated with western blotting. Molecular docking predicted binding sites for Rutin and STAT3. RESULTS: Rutin treatment undercut M5-urged viability increase and proliferation boost in HaCaT cells. Moreover, M5 stimulation mediated upregulation of IL-6, TNF-alpha, CXCL1, CXCL2, S100A7, and S100A8 was partially reversed after Rutin treatment. In addition, M5 stimulation induced downregulation of Keratin1 and Keratin5 proteins as well as upregulation of p-JAK2 and p-STAT3 proteins were attenuated in response to Rutin treatment, manifesting that Rutin treatment inhibited M5-promoted aberrant differentiation and impaired M5-mediated activation of the JAK2/STAT3 signaling in HaCaT cells. Molecular docking discovered that residues GLN326 and ASP334 in STAT3 might bind to Rutin. CONCLUSION: Rutin treatment blocked the JAK2/STAT3 signaling, thus attenuating psoriasis-related inflammation and anomalous differentiation in keratinocytes.
abstract_zh: 背景：银屑病是一种慢性炎症性皮肤病，可导致多种器官的系统性炎症。芦丁（Rutin）已被提出可用于对抗银屑病，但其作用的信号通路仍需探索。材料与方法：使用白细胞介素（IL）-17、IL-22、肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-alpha）、IL-1α和制瘤素M（M5）共刺激的HaCaT细胞作为银屑病的体外细胞模型。通过5-乙炔基-2'-脱氧尿苷和细胞计数实验测定HaCaT细胞的增殖和活力。通过逆转录-定量PCR检测IL-6、TNF-alpha、趋化因子（CXCL1和CXCL2）以及抗微生物肽（S100A7和S100A8）的相对mRNA水平。通过酶联免疫吸附实验测量HaCaT细胞释放的IL-6和TNF-alpha。通过蛋白质印迹法评估角蛋白1（Keratin1）、角蛋白5（Keratin5）、p-JAK2和p-STAT3蛋白水平。分子对接预测了芦丁与STAT3的结合位点。结果：芦丁处理削弱了M5诱导的HaCaT细胞活力增加和增殖促进。此外，M5刺激介导的IL-6、TNF-alpha、CXCL1、CXCL2、S100A7和S100A8上调在芦丁处理后部分逆转。另外，M5刺激诱导的Keratin1和Keratin5蛋白下调以及p-JAK2和p-STAT3蛋白上调在芦丁处理下得到缓解，表明芦丁处理抑制了M5促进的异常分化，并削弱了M5介导的HaCaT细胞中JAK2/STAT3信号通路激活。分子对接发现STAT3中的残基GLN326和ASP334可能结合芦丁。结论：芦丁处理阻断了JAK2/STAT3信号通路，从而减轻了角质形成细胞中银屑病相关的炎症和异常分化。
